credential_type.quote: On application, the board may issue the following classes or kinds of permits: 1. If approved by the board, a pharmacy, limited service pharmacy, automated prescription-dispensing kiosk, full service wholesale drug, third-party logistics provider, nonprescription drug wholesale and drug manufacturer's permit.

is_mandatory.quote: A person that resides in this state or in any other jurisdiction and that sells a narcotic or other controlled substance, a prescription-only drug or device, a nonprescription drug, a precursor chemical or a restricted chemical within or into this state shall hold a valid board-issued permit.

title_protection.quote: Any person desiring to operate, maintain, open or establish a pharmacy, wholesaling firm or manufacturing plant, or any other place in which or from which drugs are manufactured, compounded, dispensed, stocked, exposed, sold or offered for sale, shall apply to the board for a permit before engaging in any such activity.

scope_protection.quote: A person that resides in this state or in any other jurisdiction and that sells a narcotic or other controlled substance, a prescription-only drug or device, a nonprescription drug, a precursor chemical or a restricted chemical within or into this state shall hold a valid board-issued permit. If the person does not hold a valid board-issued permit, the person is subject to disciplinary action by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing a felony or a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude or any drug-related offense
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing a felony, whether or not involving moral turpitude, or a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude or any drug-related offense.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing an act substantially related to the qualifications, functions or duties of a permittee demonstrating unfitness
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing an act that is substantially related to the qualifications, functions or duties of a permittee and that demonstrates an actual or potential unfitness to hold a permit in light of the public's safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Working under the influence of alcohol or other drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Working under the influence of alcohol or other drugs.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using alcohol or drugs to a degree rendering the permittee unfit to perform employment duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using alcohol or other drugs to such a degree as to render the permittee unfit to perform the permittee's employment duties.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a federal or state law or administrative rule relating to the manufacture, sale or distribution of drugs, devices, poisons, hazardous substances or precursor chemicals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a federal or state law or administrative rule relating to the manufacture, sale or distribution of drugs, devices, poisons, hazardous substances or precursor chemicals.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a federal or state law or administrative rule relating to marijuana, prescription-only drugs, narcotics, dangerous drugs, controlled substances or precursor chemicals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a federal or state law or administrative rule relating to marijuana, prescription-only drugs, narcotics, dangerous drugs, controlled substances or precursor chemicals.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating state or federal reporting or recordkeeping requirements on transactions relating to precursor chemicals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating state or federal reporting or recordkeeping requirements on transactions relating to precursor chemicals.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intending to sell, transfer or distribute an imitation controlled substance, imitation over-the-counter drug or imitation prescription-only drug
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intending to sell, transfer or distribute, or to offer for sale, transfer or distribution, or selling, transferring, distributing or dispensing or offering for sale, transfer or distribution an imitation controlled substance, imitation over-the-counter drug or imitation prescription-only drug as defined in section 13-3451.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having the permittee's permit denied or disciplined in another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having the permittee's permit to manufacture, sell, distribute or dispense drugs, devices, poisons, hazardous substances or precursor chemicals denied or disciplined in another jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing an offense in another jurisdiction that if committed in this state would be grounds for discipline
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing an offense in another jurisdiction that if committed in this state would be grounds for discipline.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a permit or permit renewal by fraud, misrepresentation or knowingly taking advantage of another's mistake
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain a permit or a permit renewal by fraud, by misrepresentation or by knowingly taking advantage of the mistake of another person or an agency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Wilfully making a false report or record required by this chapter or federal or state laws
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wilfully making a false report or record that is required by this chapter, that is required by federal or state laws pertaining to drugs, devices, poisons, hazardous substances or precursor chemicals or that is required to pay for drugs, devices, poisons or hazardous substances or precursor chemicals or for services pertaining to such drugs or substances.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly filing with the board any application, renewal or other document containing false or misleading information
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly filing with the board any application, renewal or other document that contains false or misleading information.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing false or misleading information or omitting material information in any communication to the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing false or misleading information or omitting material information in any communication to the board or the board's employees or agents.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisting in or abetting the violation of, or conspiring to violate this chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisting in or abetting the violation of, or conspiring to violate this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating a formal order, terms of probation, a consent agreement or a stipulation issued or entered into by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a formal order, terms of probation, a consent agreement or a stipulation issued or entered into by the board or its executive director pursuant to this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with a board subpoena or failing to comply in a timely manner without explanation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with a board subpoena or failing to comply in a timely manner with a board subpoena without providing any explanation to the board for not complying with the subpoena.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide the board or its agents with access to any permitted place for inspection
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide the board or its employees or agents or an authorized federal or state official conducting a site investigation, inspection or audit with access to any place for which a permit has been issued or for which an application for a permit has been submitted.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to notify the board of a change of ownership, management or pharmacist in charge
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to notify the board of a change of ownership, management or pharmacist in charge.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to promptly produce on request any book, record or document during an inspection or audit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to promptly produce on the request of the official conducting a site investigation, inspection or audit any book, record or document.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Overruling or attempting to overrule a pharmacist in matters of pharmacy ethics or interpreting laws pertaining to the practice of pharmacy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Overruling or attempting to overrule a pharmacist in matters of pharmacy ethics or interpreting laws pertaining to the practice of pharmacy or the distribution of drugs or devices.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Distributing premiums or rebates in connection with the sale of prescription medication other than to the recipient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Distributing premiums or rebates of any kind in connection with the sale of prescription medication, other than to the prescription medication recipient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to maintain effective controls against the diversion of controlled substances or precursor chemicals to unauthorized persons
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to maintain effective controls against the diversion of controlled substances or precursor chemicals to unauthorized persons or entities.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently claiming to have performed a service
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulently claiming to have performed a service.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulently charging a fee for a service
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulently charging a fee for a service.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising drugs or devices in a manner that is untrue or misleading
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising drugs or devices, or services pertaining to drugs or devices, in a manner that is untrue or misleading in any particular, and that is known, or that by the exercise of reasonable care should be known, to be untrue or misleading.

bonding_required.quote: A full-service wholesale permittee that engages in the wholesale distribution of prescription-only drugs into, within or from this state must maintain a bond as required by federal law and have a designated representative.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: the board or its agents have free access, during the hours reported with the board or the posted hours at the facility, to any pharmacy, manufacturer, wholesaler, third-party logistics provider, nonprescription drug permittee or other establishment in which drugs, devices, poisons or hazardous substances are manufactured, processed, packed or held

definition_quote.value: "Wholesale distribution" means distribution of a drug to a person other than a consumer or patient.
definition_quote.quote: "Wholesale distribution" means distribution of a drug to a person other than a consumer or patient.

value: distribution of over-the-counter drugs and devices
methods_authorized.quote: a permittee who may distribute prescription-only drugs and devices, controlled substances and over-the-counter drugs and devices to pharmacies or other legal outlets from a place devoted in whole or in part to wholesaling these items.

drug_authority.value: Full-service wholesale permittees may distribute prescription-only drugs, controlled substances, and over-the-counter drugs and devices to pharmacies or other legal outlets; nonprescription drug wholesale permittees may distribute only over-the-counter drugs and devices.
drug_authority.quote: a permittee who may distribute prescription-only drugs and devices, controlled substances and over-the-counter drugs and devices to pharmacies or other legal outlets from a place devoted in whole or in part to wholesaling these items.

license_per_facility_required.quote: If it is desired to operate, maintain, open or establish more than one pharmacy, or any other place of business in which or from which drugs are sold, manufactured, compounded, dispensed, stocked, exposed or offered for sale, a separate application shall be made and a separate permit shall be issued for each place, business or outlet.

surety_bond_required.quote: A full-service wholesale permittee that engages in the wholesale distribution of prescription-only drugs into, within or from this state must maintain a bond as required by federal law

license_renewal_fee_dollars.quote: A full service wholesale drug permit or a third-party logistics provider permit, not more than $1,000.

revocation_reinstatement_waiting_period_.quote: "Revocation" or "revoke" means the official cancellation of a license, permit, registration or other approval authorized by the board for a period of two years unless otherwise specified by the board.

application_change_notification_period_d.quote: The permittee fails to update the permittee's online profile to reflect a new designated representative within ten days after the position change.

value: Intracompany transactions between divisions, subsidiaries, parents or affiliated companies under common ownership and control
Selling, purchasing, distributing, transferring or trading a drug for emergency medical reasons including transfers between pharmacies to alleviate temporary shortages
Drug returns by a hospital, health care entity, retail pharmacy or charitable institution per 21 CFR 203.23
Sale of prescription drugs by a pharmacy not exceeding five percent of gross sales to practitioners for office use
Dispensing by a retail pharmacy of prescription drugs to a patient pursuant to a lawful order of a practitioner

excluded_transaction_types.quote: Wholesale distribution does not include: (a) Any transaction or transfer between any division, subsidiary, parent or affiliated or related company under common ownership and control of a corporate entity. (b) Selling, purchasing, distributing, transferring or trading a drug or offering to sell, purchase, distribute, transfer or trade a drug for emergency medical reasons.

virtual_manufacturer_recognized.quote: "Virtual manufacturer" means an entity that contracts for the manufacture of a drug or device, including a private label distributor as defined in 21 Code of Federal Regulations part 207.1

criminal_penalty_first_offense.value: Class 2 misdemeanor (without intent to defraud or mislead)
criminal_penalty_first_offense.quote: a person who violates this chapter: 1. Without the intent to defraud or mislead is guilty of a class 2 misdemeanor.

responsible_persons_list_required.quote: The designated representative of a full-service wholesale permittee must: 1. Be at least twenty-one years of age. 2. Be employed by the full-service wholesale permittee in a managerial level position.
